result.summary: Found several visual issues: a restaurant name truncated mid-word, an incomplete delivery fee line under a card, and a discount badge showing a confusing '-100%' label.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off mid-word under the third 'Fastest near you' card, making the name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure cards/titles fully display restaurant names without clipping.

issues.description: Under the third 'Fastest near you' card, the delivery fee text appears incomplete as '€1.90 deliverv' (or similarly truncated), so users cannot read the full fee information.
issues.suggestion: Give delivery fee labels enough width or allow wrapping so the full string (e.g. '€1.90 delivery') is always visible.

issues.description: The pizza card shows a green badge reading '-100%', which looks broken or nonsensical as a discount (implying free or negative price) rather than a clear offer.
issues.suggestion: Use a clear promo label such as '100% off', 'Free', or the actual discount percentage/amount, and validate badge copy before display.

issues.description: Category filter chips extend past the right edge with only a partial next chip visible, which can feel unfinished even if horizontal scrolling is intended.
issues.suggestion: Add subtle fade/peek affordance or padding so the scrollable chip row looks intentional and balanced.
